- Reverting `stage_corner`'s `None => stage_kv(edits, corner, glyph)?,` gives **2544 passed, 0 failed**.

So both labels this PR adds could be dropped without any test noticing. Please add rows to `test_border_rejections_echo_the_typed_value_under_their_surface` along the lines of `border side top "a)"` → `border side top: unmatched ')'…` and a corner glyph that `stage_kv` refuses. Include one `canvas …` surface, so it is the label (not a literal `border`) that is pinned.
